evidence.quote: Foremost among its announcements today, Nvidia took the wraps off a new member of the Rubin GPU family called Rubin HPC , a chip that the company says is meant to accelerate agentic workflows and simulation for scientists, engineers, and analysts working with large data sets.
Nvidia says Rubin HPC will arrive sometime in 2028.

title: Nvidia announces Rubin HPC GPU with 'record number of CUDA cores' at Supercomputing 2026
displayTitle: 英伟达公布 Rubin HPC 加速器，计划 2028 年推出
summary: 英伟达在 SC26 公布面向科学计算与智能体工作流的 Rubin HPC GPU，称 CUDA 核心数超过五万，计划 2028 年推出；关键存储规格尚未公布。
investorNote: 远期路线图体现 AI 与科学计算融合方向，尚不足以推算交付能力或实测性能。
